title: Pure Ogdoadic
summary: Pure Ogdoadic Reptile graveyard build with generic staples. Small Level 4 LIGHT and DARK Ogdoadics send high-Level Ogdoadic bosses from the Deck to the GY, and those bosses Tribute monsters on the field to revive themselves from the GY and disrupt the opponent.

summary.title: Starters
points: Nunu, the Ogdoadic Remnant sends itself from the hand to the GY to send 1 DARK Reptile (such as Nauya, Zohah, Keurse, or Aleirtt) from the Deck to the GY, then revives itself if you control no monsters or control an Ogdoadic.

Nauya, the Ogdoadic Remnant sends itself from the hand to the GY to send 1 LIGHT Reptile (such as Nunu, Flogos, Aron, Amunessia, Ogdoabyss, or Nephilabyss) from the Deck to the GY, and searches any Ogdoadic Spell or Trap when Normal or Special Summoned.
Ogdoadic Water Lily sends 1 Reptile from the Deck to the GY, and if you have 5+ Reptiles with different names in your GY after resolving, Special Summons 1 Reptile from your GY.

summary.title: Opening: Nunu, the Ogdoadic Remnant
steps: Send Nunu, the Ogdoadic Remnant from your hand to the GY to mill DARK Level 8 Keurse, the Ogdoadic Light (or Zohah to search Nauya), then Special Summon Nunu from the GY.

Tribute Nunu on the field to Special Summon Keurse, the Ogdoadic Light from the GY; Keurse revives a Level 4 or lower Ogdoadic (or Nauya, the Ogdoadic Remnant) from the GY, and Nauya searches Ogdoadic Water Lily or Ogdoadic Daybreak.

Activate Ogdoadic Water Lily (or Nauya's hand effect) to dump Nephilabyss, the Ogdoadic Overlord or Ogdoabyss, the Ogdoadic Overlord into the GY; Nephilabyss triggers on any card sent from the hand or Deck to the GY to revive itself and bring back another monster from the GY.

summary.title: GY Tribute Revival & Token Fuel
summary.text: Keurse (1 Tribute), Aleirtt (1 Tribute), Aron (2 Tributes), Amunessia (2 Tributes), and Ogdoabyss (3 Tributes) all Special Summon themselves directly from the GY by Tributing monsters you control. While Keurse and Aleirtt give the opponent a small GY revival or recovery in return, Ogdoadic Daybreak banishes a Reptile you control to spawn 2 Ogdoadic Tokens that pay the 2- or 3-Tribute cost for Aron, Amunessia, or Ogdoabyss without losing board presence.

summary.title: Bosses, Control & Lock
points: Nephilabyss, the Ogdoadic Overlord Special Summons itself from the GY whenever a monster is sent from either hand or Deck to the GY, and revives any monster from your GY except itself (locking you to Reptiles while Nephilabyss remains face-up).
Ogdoabyss, the Ogdoadic Overlord (3100 ATK) activates as a Quick Effect once while face-up on the field to send all monsters on the field to the GY except monsters Special Summoned from the GY.

Aron, the Ogdoadic King sends a random card from the opponent's hand to the GY whenever they add a card outside the Draw Phase, and Amunessia, the Ogdoadic Queen sends a card from the opponent's field or hand to the GY whenever a monster is Special Summoned from their GY.

Reptile Lock: Nunu, the Ogdoadic Remnant (when revived by its own effect), Nephilabyss (when reviving a monster), and Ogdoadic Daybreak (after spawning Tokens) restrict you to Special Summoning only Reptile monsters while face-up or for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ogdoadic Serpent Strike sends a monster from the hand or field to the GY to Special Summon a Reptile with a different original Attribute from the GY, and mills a Reptile from the Deck when an opponent's monster goes to the GY.

Ogdoadic Origin sends a card the opponent controls to the GY when a face-up Reptile you control is destroyed, and Ogdoadic Calling / Ogdoadic Hollow summon Tokens or steal monsters from the opponent's GY.

main: Nauya, the Ogdoadic Remnant
Starter: mills a LIGHT Reptile; searches an Ogdoadic Spell/Trap.
Nunu, the Ogdoadic Remnant
Mills a DARK Reptile; revives itself.
Nephilabyss, the Ogdoadic Overlord
Newest boss: summons itself on a hand or Deck mill; revives a monster.
Zohah, the Ogdoadic Boundless
Searches an Ogdoadic monster; returns to the hand from the GY.
Flogos, the Ogdoadic Boundless
Swaps their field monster for a weaker one from their GY.
Keurse, the Ogdoadic Light
Revives itself and a small Ogdoadic.
Aleirtt, the Ogdoadic Dark
Revives itself; returns banished monsters to the GY.
Aron, the Ogdoadic King
Revives itself; discards from their hand when they search.
Amunessia, the Ogdoadic Queen
Revives itself; sends their card to the GY when they revive.
Ogdoabyss, the Ogdoadic Overlord
Revives itself; sends every other monster to the GY.
Ogdoadic Water Lily
Mills a Reptile; revives one with five different Reptiles in the GY.
Ogdoadic Serpent Strike
Swaps a monster for a GY Reptile of another Attribute; mills a Reptile.
Ogdoadic Daybreak
Newest Quick-Play: turns a Reptile into Tokens; recycles a banished Reptile.
Ogdoadic Origin
Field Spell: sends their card to the GY when your Reptile falls.
Ogdoadic Calling
Two Tokens, or two Reptiles back from the GY late game.
Ogdoadic Hollow
Tributes a Reptile to borrow a monster from their GY.
extra: Link-3: forces all opponent's monsters with A-Counters into Defense Position and prevents them from activating their effects.
